title: Flame Extinguishment Experiment (FLEX)
objectives: Map flammability and extinction limits for liquid-fuel droplets, assess gaseous suppressants including CO2, helium, and SF6, and improve predictive models for flame extinction in reduced gravity.
approach: Ignite relatively large isolated liquid droplets under microgravity. Vary pressure, oxygen fraction, and suppressant gas concentrations; image the droplets and flames to quantify burning and extinction and estimate the limiting oxygen index.
